evals.name: source-runtime
evals.subject: source-runtime
evals.prompt: How should we package report-builder for Git installation using evals/inputs/typescript.md?
assertions: Separates editable TypeScript/build inputs from contained emitted JavaScript and exact locked production closure
Defines relative launcher resolution, no installation-time package manager and an isolated-copy behavior check
Uses supplied runtime contracts or prose requirements, not invented portable/vendor fields
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: native-design
evals.subject: native-design
evals.prompt: Could you plan report-builder’s native archives from evals/inputs/native.md?
assertions: Uses the unspecified-language TypeScript branch without making it universal
Distinguishes pinned build/target inventory from matching-target runtime evidence
Marks all five native target cells untested and does not claim current creator native tooling
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: mixed-profile
evals.subject: mixed-profile
evals.prompt: Is the package described in evals/inputs/mixed.json ready to install? What needs changing?
assertions: Finds the exact native-only contract violations in scripts/tool.mjs and runtime/packages/example/index.js
Does not execute ambiguous entrypoints or invent precedence
Proposes a clean contract-compatible regeneration and subsequent integrity/behavior checks
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: whole-plugin-handoff
evals.subject: whole-plugin-handoff
evals.prompt: À partir de evals/inputs/handoff.md, prépare la remise pour la revue du manifeste complet et la diffusion du plugin.
assertions: Routes manual whole-plugin manifest review and separately authorized installation/publication to plugin-creator
Hands off supplied command behavior and Linux-x64-only source evidence, with native and host gaps explicit
Does not invent hashes, installation, publication or a whole-plugin validation CLI
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: rust-design
evals.subject: rust-design
evals.prompt: How should index-builder be distributed using evals/inputs/rust.md?
assertions: Keeps Cargo workspace/build inputs outside installed artifacts and records toolchain/lock/features/target/linkage requirements
Chooses exact prebuilt target artifacts with a documented selector or marks Git mode unsupported
Requires matching-target execution and does not apply a universal Node launcher or install-time Cargo
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: python-design
evals.subject: python-design
evals.prompt: Could you propose dataset-checker packaging from evals/inputs/python.md?
assertions: Derives closure from committed uv.lock and pinned uv/Python, not installation-time pip/uv
Uses a contained pure-Python interpreter artifact with user/project package fallback disabled
Treats compiled wheels as target/ABI-specific or unsupported and separates frozen-target evidence from interpreter success
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.

evals.name: launcher-verification
evals.subject: launcher-verification
evals.prompt: Please verify the launcher in evals/inputs/launcher and report what works and what remains unproven.
assertions: Actually invokes the declared launcher in a disposable isolated copy and observes exact echo argv/stdout/status
Observes fail stderr/status 7 and unknown-operation status 2
Tests traversal, absolute mapping, symlink escape, missing entry and bad hash refusals before payload stdout
Retained input bytes remain unchanged and source execution is not labelled native or host proof
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bounded packaging design, verdict or verification report for the supplied input.
